name: User journey smoke test
description: Create a browser-based smoke test. Requires a running app and Playwright browser.

parameters.label: Evaluation name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring evaluation.

parameters.label: Browser base URL
parameters.tooltip: Public URL that Playwright opens while collecting browser evidence. Leave blank only when this Quick Start does not use a browser.

parameters.label: User journey name
parameters.placeholder: e.g. Sign in and view orders
parameters.tooltip: Short, stable name shown for this fixed evaluation case.

parameters.label: Journey start path
parameters.tooltip: Path opened first by the browser journey, relative to the browser base URL.

parameters.label: User actions
parameters.placeholder: e.g. Sign in with the test account and open order history.
parameters.tooltip: The exact user request or task supplied to the evaluated target.

parameters.label: Success condition
parameters.placeholder: e.g. The order history page loads without an error.
parameters.tooltip: Observable evidence required for this case to be considered successful.

parameters.label: Expected visible text (optional)
parameters.tooltip: Optional text that must be visibly rendered for the browser case to pass.

parameters.label: AI model profile
parameters.tooltip: Select an existing AI model profile, or create one for this build.

runner.name: ${build_name} runner
runner.description: Browser journey runner created by Quick Start.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Assess the fixed browser journey evidence and return the required evaluation JSON.

test_case_set.name: ${build_name} smoke tests
test_case_set.description: A smoke journey created by Quick Start.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Evaluate the browser journey created by Quick Start.
